_comment: FabFilter Pro-L 2 - names verified via config/last-device-params.txt dump (direct parameters only; Style/Threshold/Linear Phase/Oversampling are not exposed by the plugin). Knobs 6/7 use range scaling: full knob travel covers the useful first half of the link parameters. Knobs 10-12 are toggles: the knob jumps between off/on across its range. Channel Link Center/LFE and Receive Midi are left unmapped deliberately.
